document_metadata.title: 78、INT. BEVERLY'S PICK-UP - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Barbara pulls over after an emotional moment, collects herself, and stares into the prairie, exhausted but beginning to find relief and clarity amid uncertainty.

entities.name: Barbara pulls over and exits her vehicle after emotional distress
entities.description: Barbara, visibly shaken and tearful, slows her pickup truck and pulls to the side of the road at the top of a small rise, then climbs out to stand and stare over the prairie.

entities.name: Barbara composes herself while standing on a prairie overlook
entities.description: After exiting her vehicle, Barbara stands in the wind, ruffled by the breeze, settling into a state of exhausted relief as she confronts her emotional turmoil and begins to regain composure.
